messages:
Priya M: Quick sync 1: we want to lower the `renewal_risk_score` playbook trigger from 0.70 -> 0.65. Seeing missed early flags on deals that churned in last two quarters. Thoughts?

Noah K: Do we have concrete numbers for misses? ROC/AUC?

Priya M: Summary from model ops: recall@0.70 = 0.62, recall@0.65 = 0.74 on last-90d labeled set. Missed renewals (false negatives) falling from 38 -> 12 in the sample.

Noah K: good improvement. What's the lift on false positives (FP)?

Priya M: FP rate rises from 0.09 -> 0.14. That's ~1.5k extra accounts flagged org-wide monthly.

Elena S: 1.5k extra flags/month is manageable but we need playbook automation to limit noise. Suggest: only create AM tasks for accounts >0.65 AND ARR > $5k, otherwise create a low-touch nurture sequence.

Devon R: I can add conditional branching to the automation engine. Proposed rule pseudocode:
```
if renewal_risk_score >= 0.65 and ARR >= 5000:
  create AM task (priority: high)
  notify slack channel #cs-renewals
else if renewal_risk_score >= 0.65:
  enqueue nurture cadence (email + in-app nudge)
```

Priya M: love that. Also plan to tag model-run id and score threshold in the task payload for audit (fields: model_id, model_version, threshold_applied).

Noah K: Can you paste the SQL we used to compute counts so I can sanity-check?

Priya M: SQL we ran on the labeled set: 
```
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN renewal_risk_score >= 0.70 AND renewed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fn_070,
  SUM(CASE WHEN renewal_risk_score >= 0.65 AND renewed = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fn_065,
  SUM(CASE WHEN renewal_risk_score >= 0.65 AND ARR >= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as flagged_high_arr
FROM renewals_labeled_90d;
```

Noah K: ran it locally, numbers match. flagged_high_arr = 420 for the sample window.

Elena S: For AMs, we need an email template and PS talking points when a high-ARR account is flagged. I can draft and push to the playbooks repo.

Priya M: Timeline proposal: staging deploy of rule + dry-run notifications week of 2025-09-08, soft rollout Friday 2025-09-12, full enable Monday 2025-09-15.

Devon R: I'll create a staging workflow with `dry_run=true` and webhook to a test workspace. cs-bot can schedule it. Sample curl to create workflow: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://automations.redwood/api/v1/workflows \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"name":"renewal-threshold-065-staging","rule":"...","dry_run":true}'
```

Priya M: Gate conditions (proposal): pause rollout if error rate on task creation > 0.8% OR if AM reported false positive ratio > 20% on a 48h sample. Also cap daily AM inbox adds to 50 per region during first week.

Noah K: I'll add monitoring dashboards: daily counts, FP/TP labels (when available), avg ARR of flagged accounts, and a running A/B slice comparing 0.70 vs 0.65 cohorts.

Elena S: I'll schedule a 30-min enablement sync for AMs Tues 2025-09-09 to review templates and triage flow.

Devon R: cs-bot: scheduling staging workflow `renewal-threshold-065-staging` for 2025-09-08 03:00 UTC -> https://jobs.redwood/reports/991

cs-bot: Workflow `renewal-threshold-065-staging` created (dry_run) and linked to test workspace. Run ID: wf-20250908-991.

Priya M: owners: Priya (owner), Devon (automation), Noah (metrics), Elena (enablement). Please add any blockers here.

Noah K: one ask: keep raw flagged list exportable for manual review by AMs (CSV) with columns: account_id, score, ARR, model_version, last_touch_date.

Elena S: noted, will include as a downloadable report in the AM playbook page.

Priya M: next steps: push PR to playbooks repo with templates + runbook, Devon to push staging workflow and link job here, Noah to wire dashboards. Reconvene after dry-run results for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
